description: Daily harvested farm-fresh organic vegetables grown without synthetic chemicals.
Tree-ripened, naturally sweet organic fruits bursting with authentic seasonal flavor.
Ancient heirloom varieties, unpolished indigenous rice, and nutrient-dense millets.
Unpolished, chemical-free native dals naturally high in digestible plant protein.
Wood-churned (Kachi Ghani) pure unfiltered oils retaining natural aromas and nutrients.
Grass-fed A2 Gir cow ghee, organic farm milk, and artisanal almond/oat mylks.
Raw unpasteurized forest honey, organic unrefined jaggery, and coconut flower sugar.
Wholesome roasted seeds, sun-dried organic nuts, and guilt-free millet crisps.
Single-origin aromatic spices from Wayanad and organic herbs rich in essential oils.
Stone-ground whole wheat flours, raw rock salts, and whole grain organic pastas.
